submission.justification: In the unirradiated simulation, Sensor-T3 gave the best resolution at every thickness. At 150 um it gave 6.08 um, against 8.97 um for T2 and 14.2 um for T1. The T3 optimum is broad, at about 150-175 um. The finer scan gave 6.06 um at 125 um and 5.95 um at 175 um, and the fitted unirradiated optimum is about 165 um. I recommend 150 um, which is the value the earlier steps recorded. It is within about 2% of the best scanned value. The main caveat is that no radiation-hardness data was found in the 6 documents checked. Irradiated resolution was not simulated. No technology was excluded on documented evidence. So I could not confirm that T3 is suitable for the innermost-layer radiation environment, and the result rests on unirradiated simulation. Radiation tolerance of T3 should be checked before the design is finalized. Irradiation will probably favor thinner sensors, which is another reason not to go thicker than 150 um.

requirements.evidence: This holds for the unirradiated simulation only. T3 gave 6.08 um at 150 um, against 8.97 um for T2 and 14.2 um for T1. T3 was the best at every thickness scanned.
